kpis.nom_fr: Croissance des ventes systeme du 1er semestre
kpis.nom_source: system sales in the first half of the year
kpis.citation: Even year to date, system sales in the first half of the year are up 7%, and G&A, if you back out FX and acquisition-related G&A, G&A's been flat.

kpis.nom_fr: Frais generaux en pourcentage des ventes systeme
kpis.citation: The 1.7% G&A percent of system sales, we believe, is still relevant, and we will continue to expect operating leverage on system sales growth going forward.

kpis.nom_fr: Part du numerique Taco Bell en 2018
kpis.citation: You'll remember that in 2018, we had a 1% digital mix on Taco Bell, so it's a dramatic change to that 47% today.

kpis.nom_fr: Part des ventes KFC hors Etats-Unis
kpis.nom_source: KFC system sales outside of the U.S.
kpis.citation: When we talk about Raise the B.A.R at KFC, we're talking about that as a global initiative. 88% of our KFC system sales are outside of the U.S.

kpis.nom_fr: Objectif de volume moyen Taco Bell
kpis.citation: Roy, just on Taco Bell, I appreciate the strong 2Q trends and the new action plan you shared to get back on track to reach $3 million volumes by 2030.

kpis.nom_fr: Objectif de retour sur investissement par marque et pays
kpis.citation: We want every brand country combination to be moving to that five-year payback or better over time through leveraging Yum!'s scale.

kpis.nom_fr: Restaurants KFC hors Etats-Unis
kpis.citation: But if you think about the global breadth of KFC with more than 30,000 restaurants outside the U.S., we need a relevant beverage offering to be able to bring to that next generation of consumers there.
